<!-- generated by FlowCast Studio from https://wso2.com/integration-platform/docs/connectors/catalog/developer-tools/wso2.apim.catalog/example -->

## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `Example`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `wso2-apim-catalog-example`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **Example**.

## Step 2: Open the add connection panel

1. Select **+** (Add) icon in the **Connections** section of the side panel to open the Add Connection palette.

## Step 3: Fill in connection parameters

1. <!-- manual: Enter the connection details, binding each field to a configurable variable so credentials are never hardcoded. - Connection Name : A unique name for this connection instance - Config : The ConnectionConfig record containing the auth block with username and password bound to configurable variables -->

## Step 4: Save the connection

1. Select **Save Connection** to persist the connection.

## Step 5: Set actual values for your configurables

1. In the left panel, select **Configurations**.
2. Run the shell command `.venv/bin/python tools/write_config.py --project wso2-apim-catalog-example --expect apimUsername,apimPassword` to set the configurable values.

## Step 6: Add an automation entry point

1. <!-- manual: In the side panel, navigate to Entry Points. -->
2. Select **+** to add a new entry point.
3. Select **Automation** as the entry point type and name it `main`.

## Step 7: Select and configure the import a service operation

1. Select **catalogClient**.
2. <!-- manual: Expand the catalogClient node in the node panel to reveal all available operations, then select Import a service and fill in the required fields. - Payload : A Services_import_body record containing file.fileContent (byte array of the service definition) and file.fileName (name of the service definition file) - Result : Output variable that holds the ServiceInfoList response listing imported services -->
